title: 45-day-onboarding-health-check-and-interview-notes
content:
Purpose: quick synthesis from the 45-day onboarding touchpoints (eng hires in Q1 cohort) + short section with recent interview debriefs that surfaced process friction. Goal is to capture high-signal issues we can act on before next onboarding wave.

Attendees / inputs: Claire (owner), Samir (mentor lead), Michelle (hiring coordinator), Jonah (tech lead), Priya (people ops); notes pulled from mentor check-ins, M1/M2 survey results, and weekly syncs.

High-level summary:
- Overall ramp: 4 of 6 ICs on track to reach baseline production tasks within 60 days; 2 are behind due to environment access + unclear local dev path.
- Mentorship load: mentors report average 4.5 hours/week of ad-hoc help; spike during first three weeks, steadying now.
- Documentation gaps: local infra README needs step-by-step for GPU-enabled model runs; a one-off script exists but is not in repo root.
- Process friction: interview scheduling delays (candidate feedback loop ~6 days) causing slower offers.

Concrete observations and quotes (raw):
- "I spent 2 days debugging my tooling because the Makefile assumes gcloud creds we don't use." — new hire A
- "My mentor was great, but there wasn't a clear list of small starter bugs to build context quickly." — new hire B
- "Interview kit has grown stale; PR examples referenced in round 2 are no longer applicable." — interviewer J

45-day metrics snapshot (operational):
- Time-to-first-PR merged: median 18 days (target <=14)
- Time-to-local-gpu-run: median 7 days (target <=3)
- Mentor satisfaction (self-reported): 4.2/5
- New-hire sentiment (survey): 3.8/5 with notes about docs and infra setup

Action items (owner, ETA):
- Add a targeted "first-week dev checklist" to repo root that includes GPU setup and a tiny end-to-end toy model run (owner: Samir, ETA: 2026-03-10).
- Create a small pool of 6 curated starter issues labeled "onboarding-starter" for next cohort (owner: Jonah, ETA: 2026-03-08).
- Shorten interview feedback loop: hiring coordinator to run weekly "close the loop" sync with interviewers to finalize notes within 72 hours (owner: Michelle, ETA: 2026-03-05).
- Audit interview kit: remove obsolete PR examples and add one live code exercise drawn from recent triage work (owner: Claire, ETA: 2026-03-17).
- Provisioning checklist: make KMS/HSM onboarding note available for Private infra hires (owner: Priya, ETA: 2026-03-12).

Interview debriefs (recent pipeline notes):
- Candidate X (SWE-III): strong infra experience, stumbling on our runtime-specific caching questions; interviewers note potential to train but unclear fit for urgent Dedicated work. Decision: keep in process for lateral infra role.
- Candidate Y (SRE): excellent on reliability and runbooks, weak on model-serving specifics; flagged for interview follow-up with serving-runtime team.
- Process gap: several interviewers referenced outdated scoring rubric (scale and competency buckets mismatched). Immediate fix: publish updated rubric and reference examples in interview kit.

Risks and open questions:
- If we don't reduce time-to-local-gpu-run, first-week excitement decays and churn risk increases.
- How many mentor hours can we sustainably commit per cohort? Need to baseline mentorship capacity for Dedicated vs Hosted product teams.
- Should we create a small "onboarding rotations" stipend to compensate mentors for high-touch weeks? Cost/benefit TBD with finance.

Notes to self / TODOs (informal):
- Pull list of 1:1 feedback from M2-survey and anonymize before sharing with platform eng.
- Sync with docs owner (karen@redwood) to push the Makefile rewrite; maybe add a setup script that toggles cloud vs local.
- Flag ENG-8791 in next hiring ops retro; remind interviewers to use new rubric.

Appendix: quick checklist for next cohort launch:
- Repo: add onboarding-starter label + checklist in README
- Mentors: weekly office hour slot calendar block + mentor pairing matrix
- Hiring: 72-hour feedback SLAs + refined rubric doc link (confluence:ONBOARD-45-summary)

Unresolved: do we want mandatory "first-week pairing" with senior engineer for 4 hours minimum? Leave as proposal for people ops and team leads.

End of note.

(Links referenced above: confluence:ONBOARD-45-summary, JIRA:ENG-8791, slack:#onboarding-updates-thread)
